sources.name: Web search: trends (Exa)
sources.objective: Recent Korean news, reports or blog posts from the last month about foods, convenience-store products or menus that are newly released or popular now, especially for students and single-person households. Exclude shopping pages and plain recipes.
sources.note: Tier per result host (discovery.hosts). Search is discovery only; a result needs retrieved text.

sources.name: Web search: eating habits (Exa)
sources.objective: Korean news, surveys, consumer reports or research about how people eat: meal patterns, skipping meals, eating alone, single-person households, students, ready meals and lunch boxes, low-sugar and wellness eating. Prefer recent reporting and dated studies. Exclude recipes and shopping pages.
sources.note: Habit needs a Tier A/B host, a date and behavior evidence; news <= 90 days, research <= 2 years.

sources.name: Naver Blog (site search)
sources.objective: Recent Naver blog posts where people try new foods, convenience-store products or popular menus. Exclude sponsored posts and shopping pages.
sources.note: Tier C discovery: new products and what people are trying, never health or nutrition evidence. No Naver API or RSS search route exists; public site search only. Disabled 2026-10-12 (magazine sourcing plan): Naver's terms of service forbid automated collection and automated searches of its content without permission (https://policy.naver.com/rules/service.html), and the route read blog.naver.com pages; over 9/28-10/11 it gave 7 usable trend stories and 2 published.

sources.name: YouTube search (yt-dlp)
sources.note: Metadata only (--skip-download), no cookies or account. Runs on the operator PC through scripts/magazine_local_discovery.py; the pipeline reads its inbox. Disabled 2026-10-12 (owner decision, data plan phase 2): the operator-PC sidecar last delivered on 2026-09-29, and GitHub-hosted runners cannot reach YouTube.
